description: A Kotlin class defining a UI fragment called HomeFragment for an Android TV application. It constructs a TV-style interface with a background banner, top navigation labels, and multiple content rows with card items, using Leanback library components.

classes.name: HomeFragment
classes.description: An Android TV UI fragment with a background banner, top navigation labels, and multiple horizontal content rows. Implements click and selection listeners to update background and handle user interactions.

classes.name: CardItem
classes.description: A data class representing a media card with ID, title, description, and image resource.

classes.name: HeroCardPresenter
classes.description: A custom Presenter for rendering media cards with images, titles, and descriptions, designed to work with Leanback's ImageCardView.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes background, sets click and select listeners, and prepares the UI on fragment creation.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Post-initialization setup to build UI elements and content rows after the view is created.

methods.name: prepareBackground
methods.description: Configures the BackgroundManager with a placeholder banner and background color.

methods.name: setupUIAndTitleSafely
methods.description: Sets up the title, headers, branding, and asynchronously builds the top navigation bar.

methods.name: buildTopNavBarIfReady
methods.description: Builds the top navigation bar after ensuring the TitleView is ready, avoiding lifecycle race conditions.

methods.name: setTitlePaddingForTV
methods.description: Adjusts padding for overscan safety and sets font size for the TV interface.

methods.name: buildRows
methods.description: Creates and adds content rows (Continue Watching, Live TV) to the adapter.

methods.name: buildCardRow
methods.description: Constructs a row of media cards with a header.

methods.name: sampleItems
methods.description: Generates a sample list of CardItems with titles and images.

methods.name: onItemClicked
methods.description: Handles click events on media items; currently a placeholder.

methods.name: onItemSelected
methods.description: Updates the background image when a different media item is selected.
